sources.title: JingweiNi/BELT-OLMo-3-7B-Think · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: These are custom reader/head checkpoints used alongside the pinned base language model, loaded through the BELT repository's scorer. They are not standalone language models. No backbone weights, question manifests, full trajectory banks or fitted BELT stopping policies are bundled. See the code repository's recipes, asset inventory and known limitations.
